text: Which genes enhanced in classical monocytes among blood immune cells stain moderately or strongly in hematopoietic cells of the bone marrow?
plan: Immune cell category (RNA): Classical monocyte / Immune cell enhanced AND Tissue expression (IHC): Bone marrow / hematopoietic cells / Medium, High
understanding: The user wants to find genes whose RNA expression is categorized as enhanced in classical monocytes among blood immune cell types, and whose protein staining (IHC) in bone marrow hematopoietic cells is moderate or strong (Medium or High).
